name: Menagerie — Kingdom Cards, Ways & Horses (pinned)
note: Official Menagerie catalog — the 30 Kingdom cards, the Horse (non-supply 30-card pile), and the 20 Ways (landscapes) as printed (2020, Rio Grande Games). Sources: the compiled dominion-card-list catalog, cross-checked against DominionStrategy wiki infoboxes and the BGN Dominion card-image archive (rathji.neocities.org/dominion) card scans (Black Cat, Sleigh, Supplies, Camel Train, Goatherd, Scrap, Sheepdog, Snowy Village, Stockpile, Bounty Hunter, Cardinal, Cavalry, Groom, Hostelry, Barge, Coven, Displace, Falconer, Gatekeeper, Hunting Lodge, Kiln, Livery, Mastermind, Paddock, Sanctuary, Fisherman, Destrier, Wayfarer, Animal Fair, Horse; Village Green via the wiki). Roadmap Phase 19 (tasks 393-417).

cards.text: +2 Cards; If it isn't your turn, each other player gains a Curse.; When another player gains a Victory card, you may play this from your hand.
cards.name: Black Cat

cards.text: Gain 2 Horses.; When you gain a card, you may discard this, to put that card into your hand or onto your deck.
cards.name: Sleigh

cards.text: $1; Gain a Horse onto your deck.
cards.name: Supplies

cards.text: Exile a non-Victory card from the Supply.; When you gain this, Exile a Gold from the Supply.
cards.name: Camel Train

cards.text: +1 Action; You may trash a card from your hand.; +1 Card per card the player to your right trashed on their last turn.
cards.name: Goatherd

cards.text: Trash a card from your hand. Choose a different thing per $1 it costs: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Buy; +$1; gain a Silver; gain a Horse.
cards.name: Scrap

cards.text: +2 Cards; When you gain a card, you may play this from your hand.
cards.name: Sheepdog

cards.text: +1 Card; +4 Actions; +1 Buy; Ignore any further +Actions you get this turn.
cards.name: Snowy Village

cards.text: $3; +1 Buy; Exile this.
cards.name: Stockpile

cards.text: +1 Action; Exile a card from your hand. If you didn't have a copy of it in Exile, +$3.
cards.name: Bounty Hunter

cards.text: +$2; Each other player reveals the top 2 cards of their deck, Exiles one costing from $3 to $6, and discards the rest.
cards.name: Cardinal

cards.text: Gain 2 Horses.; When you gain this, +2 Cards, +1 Buy, and if it's your Buy phase return to your Action phase.
cards.name: Cavalry

cards.text: Gain a card costing up to $4. If it's an Action card, gain a Horse; Treasure card, gain a Silver; Victory card, +1 Card and +1 Action.
cards.name: Groom

cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions; When you gain this, you may discard any number of Treasures, revealed, to gain that many Horses.
cards.name: Hostelry

cards.text: Either now or at the start of your next turn, +1 Card and +2 Actions.; When you discard this other than during Clean-up, you may reveal it to play it.
cards.name: Village Green

cards.text: Either now or at the start of your next turn, +3 Cards and +1 Buy.
cards.name: Barge

cards.text: +1 Action; +$2; Each other player Exiles a Curse from the Supply. If they can't, they discard their Exiled Curses.
cards.name: Coven

cards.text: Exile a card from your hand. Gain a differently named card costing up to $2 more than it.
cards.name: Displace

cards.text: Gain a card to your hand costing less than this.; When any player gains a card with 2 or more types (Action, Attack, etc.), you may play this from your hand.
cards.name: Falconer

cards.text: At the start of your next turn, +$3. Until then, when another player gains an Action or Treasure card they don't have an Exiled copy of, they Exile it.
cards.name: Gatekeeper

cards.text: +1 Card; +2 Actions; You may discard your hand for +5 Cards.
cards.name: Hunting Lodge

cards.text: +$2; The next time you play a card this turn, you may first gain a copy of it.
cards.name: Kiln

cards.text: +$3; This turn, when you gain a card costing $4 or more, gain a Horse.
cards.name: Livery

cards.text: At the start of your next turn, you may play an Action card from your hand three times.
cards.name: Mastermind

cards.text: +$2; Gain 2 Horses.; +1 Action per empty Supply pile.
cards.name: Paddock

cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +1 Buy; You may Exile a card from your hand.
cards.name: Sanctuary

cards.text: +1 Card; +1 Action; +$1; During your turns, if your discard pile is empty, this costs $3 less.
cards.name: Fisherman

cards.text: +2 Cards; +1 Action; During your turns, this costs $1 less per card you've gained this turn.
cards.name: Destrier

cards.text: +3 Cards; You may gain a Silver.; This has the same cost as the last other card gained this turn, if any.
cards.name: Wayfarer

cards.text: +$4; +1 Buy per empty supply pile.; Instead of paying this card's cost, you may trash an Action card from your hand.
cards.name: Animal Fair

cards.text: +2 Cards; +1 Action; Return this to its pile. (This is not in the Supply.)
cards.name: Horse

cards.name: Way of the Otter
